residue.text: No structural assessment can discover an obligation omitted from the WK, this controlled contract, declared impact facets, and every shaping review result. Applicable-intent completeness remains a mandatory reviewed boundary.

The contract represents role, registration, confinement, CAS, and disk-identity obligations, but only implementation tests and findings-only review can establish actual server registration, filesystem confinement, atomicity, symlink handling, and zero-effect refusal.
Structural, profile, exact-binding, and projection facts do not establish runtime evidence, evidence sufficiency, CCE policy, organization policy, readiness, or dispatch authorization.

The root contract binds the four focused contracts and their exact proof plans, but no admitted pack establishes semantic equivalence between a root behavior claim and a focused-contract claim. That mapping remains an explicit findings-only review boundary.
Bounded query and mutation projections constrain transport volume but do not establish that an agent selected the semantically relevant nodes or that the selected context is cognitively sufficient.
